profile.name: Main Street Shears
profile.summary: A three-stylist salon in Westminster, MD that takes bookings by phone and a paper appointment book.

items.title: Online booking and reminders
items.why: Clients book by phone and you answer between clients, so reminders and online booking cut calls and no-shows.

items.title: Review replies
items.why: Happy clients are easy to thank, but replying on Google and Yelp takes time you spend in the chair.

items.title: Texts and emails to past clients
items.why: Quiet weekdays could fill with a quick offer to clients who have not been in lately.

items.title: Social posts
items.why: Photos of your work and open chairs can be posted without you writing each one.

square.prompt: A client books a haircut appointment on her phone at night on her couch; next morning the salon owner, a stylist in her 40s, sees the day's schedule on a tablet at the front desk of a small town hair salon, warm natural light, documentary style, no logos

messages.text: Here is my business: https://mainstreet-demo-sites.vercel.app/salon/. What should I try first?

Try online booking and reminders first. Right now clients book by phone and you answer between haircuts, so this could save you about 4 hours a week.

I'd start with Square. It has a free plan with no monthly fee (you pay card processing fees). It books appointments and texts clients. Setup takes about 45 minutes. Our team has verified it. We can't set it up for you, but I can give you the sign-up link.

The other two options are Allo and RingCentral. Both answer calls with AI, but they cost more: $10 to $39 a month and up.

Next on your list are review replies, texts to past clients, and social posts.

Want a short preview of Square for your salon?
Compare tools for Online booking and reminders

Here are the three options for online booking and reminders at Main Street Shears:

- Square (my pick): the free plan has no monthly fee, and you pay card processing fees. It books appointments and texts clients. Setup takes about 45 minutes. Our team has verified it.
- Allo: it answers missed calls and books visits. It costs $10 a month plus $32 for the AI receptionist. It also needs a calendar connected.
- RingCentral AI Receptionist: it answers calls day and night and texts follow-ups. The add-on starts at $39 a month on top of a phone plan. Setup takes about an hour.

We can't set up any of these for you, but I can give you the sign-up link for Square. Do you want a short preview of it?

For review replies, I'd pick RightResponse AI.

- RightResponse AI (my pick): it writes Google review replies from facts you approve. It costs from $10 a month, with a 7-day free trial. Setup takes about 30 minutes. Our team has verified it.
- Pluspoint: it replies to reviews and also does chat and social posts. It has a 3-location minimum, so one salon pays $87 a month. Our team has verified it too.

We can't set up either one for you. I can send the sign-up link for RightResponse AI. In a test with a simulated owner, connecting the Google profile was the hard part, so a local helper could make that easier.

Want a preview of RightResponse AI?
Compare tools for Texts and emails to past clients

For texts and emails to past clients, I'd pick Square.

- Square (my pick): there's no monthly fee, and you pay card processing fees. It emails and texts clients, and it also does the online booking we looked at. One tool covers two jobs. Setup takes about 45 minutes. Our team has verified it.
- Klaviyo: it's free for up to 250 contacts, and its AI drafts offers for you. Texting costs extra. Setup takes about 90 minutes. A simulated owner test found it confusing for a non-technical owner. Our team has verified it.

We can't set up either one for you. I can send the sign-up link for Square.

Want a short preview of Square?
Show me a preview of the best tool for Online booking and reminders

Your Square preview is ready on your page. It shows a client booking a haircut on her phone at night. The next morning, the salon owner sees the day's schedule on a tablet at the front desk.

It's a short illustration, not your real screen.

We can't set Square up for you. Its sign-up link is https://squareup.com/us/en/pricing. Setup takes about 45 minutes, and you can start on the free plan. If you'd like help, these local groups are free:

- Maryland SBDC: https://www.marylandsbdc.org
- SCORE: https://www.score.org/find-mentor

Don't enter a card or pick a paid plan unless you decide to. Do you want to look at review replies next?
